Course Translator

Translate course structure and supported activity text without letting the model rewrite markup, identifiers, placeholders or learner-generated content.

Supported scope
Course, sections, activities, questions and optional glossary text
Design focus
Token-protected translation
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Immutable tokens
Protect HTML tags, URLs, PLUGINFILE paths, Moodle placeholders, code, math and required terminology before AI.
✓
Review before write
Translate into a job first, compare original and translation side by side, then choose a hidden copy or explicit selected updates.
✓
Stable copy mapping
Use structural locators rather than database IDs so translated content can be applied after Moodle backup/restore changes IDs.
Original protected by default
A translated duplicate is created hidden and the original course is never overwritten automatically.
Learner content excluded
Submissions, forum posts, quiz attempts, grades and private learner content are not collected for translation.
Question-bank caution
Question fields are translated safely in the isolated copy rather than raw-updating versioned questions in the original.
What this plugin does

Course Translator treats Moodle markup and identifiers as data that must survive translation byte-for-byte where required. The model receives small identified text blocks, not permission to redesign the activity HTML.

Each source field is hashed so changes after the translation snapshot are detected. Outdated translations are refused for original-course application, and missing mappings in a duplicated course are reported instead of guessed.

Features you get
Supported activity fields
Translate Page, Book, Label, Assignment, Forum, Quiz and supported question fields.
Required terminology
Enforce source-to-target terminology deterministically rather than relying on a prompt hint.
Token validation
Reject missing, duplicated, reordered or newly introduced markup/URL tokens.
Change detection
Re-scan source hashes before preview, retranslation and application.
Hidden translated copy
Use Moodle course duplication for a reviewable isolated result.
Selective original updates
Apply only explicitly confirmed, safe non-question fields back to the original course.

Also requires AI Bridge.
